answer: Pseudonym parties: once a month, at the same global hour, every operator must join a short live video room with a few random strangers, and each person present can renew exactly one agent. Because all rooms meet at once, one human cannot show up twice, like a single boat that cannot tie up at two jetty berths at the same time. A farm of a thousand agents must hire a thousand real people for that hour, every month, so the ivory tower of fake accounts sinks like a reef-struck hull.
